A [https://www.starwarsccg.org/14-burning-questions-for-v-set-14/ PC article dated 20 March 2021] links that Spring sheet. |hatnote=Other versions of this Virtual Modern card: [[Rescue In The Clouds (V)]], [[Rescue In The Clouds (V) (Errata)]], [[Rescue In The Clouds (V) (Errata 2)]]. For the Decipher card, see [[Rescue In The Clouds]].
|rulings=* USED function works at the following locations: Any Cloud City site, any system (including [[Bespin]]), and any cloud sector connected to Cloud City or [[Bespin]] (including [[Bespin: Cloud City]]). It does not work at any asteroid sectors.<ref name="scomp">[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Rescue%20In%20The%20Clouds%20%28V%29 Scomp: Rescue In The Clouds (V)]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174249/https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json Internet Archive]</ref>
* The first function works against [[Gravity Shadow]] only if [[Gravity Shadow]] was targeting a pilot character (not a permanent pilot).
* The second function plays during the weapons segment, scheduling the 'battle destiny if unable to otherwise' for later.
* Generally, a destiny draw is targeting ability or defense value if it is used in a comparison or calculation involving ability or defense value. However, RITCv does not combo 'offensively' with [[Wookiee Strangle]] or other cards that cause both players to draw destiny.
* This card does not cancel a [[Hidden Weapons]] destiny draw.
